reviews.text: Clean practice, with always available and competent vets. For 20 years now, they have treated all the animals I've owned and still own with professionalism and care. Thank you.
Available at any time of day, professional staff, excellent clinic, and love for animals!

Not even a year has passed since I entrusted myself to Dr. Irace, a true professional, always available. He inspired trust in me from the first moment. I placed my pets in his care, a neutered kitten and my dog, who had three infected teeth removed and scaling done. My deepest respect goes to him.

Dr. IRACE is a serious, knowledgeable, and very helpful professional.
He is very empathetic with animals, whom he treats with love.

Dr. Irace has been treating my pets for years, starting with rabbits, and now he's treating my Maltipoo. What can I say? He's a great professional, and he's always available. I wouldn't trade him for anyone. 🐾❤️ …

Dr. Irace ensured that my dog, adopted in 2019, overcame Leishmaniasis with a carefully considered treatment plan implemented under his constant guidance. Therefore, I strongly recommend anyone who finds themselves in the same situation as us to contact him immediately! Without delay. And without fear. Leishmaniasis can be reversed! What I particularly like about this clinic is its constantly updated approach to medications. With a (then) newer generation, we prevented the disease from escalating. Now my little girl is doing great. There's no trace of Leishmaniasis in the tests. We've also resolved other problems, thanks to the doctor's intervention. Giulietta is the most precious thing I have in the world, along with another dog...I recommend what was crucial for her; this clinic was her salvation!

Dr. Irace has been caring for my 4-year-old mixed-breed Lucky since he was a puppy.

Always attentive and meticulous.

Loving towards his "patients."
I THANK YOU SO MUCH TO DR. IRACE WHO WITH HIS EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCE HEALED MY DOG ❤️ THANK YOU DOCTOR
